command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: FR2 / spec scenario 'The handle is filled with its card's fill' (openspec/changes/fix-location-card-and-header-layout/specs/time-selection/spec.md) requires, for the rows 'dark from the system' AND 'Dark preference with a light system' at 375 and 1024 px, '**AND** in the dark theme that colour differs from the page background' (FR2: 'for the dark theme coming from the system or from the Dark theme preference ... In the dark theme that colour differs from the page background'; task 5.2: 'in dark it differs from the <body>'s'). In packages/client/src/test/features/time_selection/time_selection_card_layout_e2e.feature the page-background check ('the visible handle of "Almaty" is not filled with the page background colour') runs only in the separate outline 'In the dark theme the handle is not the page background' with 'Given the system colour scheme is dark'; it never runs for the Dark preference with a light system. Add that check to the dark-preference rows, e.g. an outline row driven by 'the system colour scheme is light' + 'the stored preferences are theme Dark ...', or make the step part of the fill outline's dark rows.

findings.message: File size: the new file packages/client/src/test/features/time_selection/steps/time_selection_card_layout_e2e.steps.ts is 226 lines. The change's tasks.md says: "File size: every file stays under 200 lines; a steps file that would pass it gets a helper next to it." The root CLAUDE.md says: "Files must stay under 200 lines for AI context quality". Move helpers such as parseCities, boxesOfCard, the measuring code of the 'time buttons ... on one line in full' and 'hour labels ... on one line' steps, and the selector constants into a helper module next to it (e.g. steps/cardLayoutE2eHelpers.ts), so the steps file is under 200 lines.

File size: packages/client/src/test/features/locations/locations_ui_e2e.feature is 204 lines after this change added the `@fix-location-card-and-header-layout @NFR-R2` tag and the four `12-hour` example rows. That breaks the same tasks.md rule ("every file stays under 200 lines"). Bring it back under 200 lines, for example by moving the 12-hour screenshot rows into their own small screenshot outline or feature file, or by condensing the tag lines.
